A New Start in the City
Tahmini seviye B1
117 kelime
Dinle

Metni gizle (dinleme alıştırması)
Türkçe çeviriyi göster

Last spring, Elif moved from a small town to Istanbul to start her first job at a design company. At first, everything felt difficult. The city was crowded, the traffic was terrible, and she did not know anyone.

Her manager noticed that she was nervous, so he introduced her to a colleague called Deniz. Deniz showed her the best way to travel to work by ferry. The journey took longer than the metro, but it was much more relaxing.

After a few months, Elif began to enjoy her new life. She joined a running group, explored different neighbourhoods at the weekends and improved her cooking skills. She still misses her family, but she calls them every evening.

Why Do We Waste So Much Food?
Tahmini seviye B1
144 kelime
Dinle

Metni gizle (dinleme alıştırması)
Türkçe çeviriyi göster

Around the world, a large amount of food is thrown away every year. Some of it is lost on farms or during transport, but a lot of it is wasted at home. People often buy more than they need, especially when supermarkets offer special deals.

Another reason is confusion about the dates on packages. A “best before” date tells you when food is at its best quality, but the food is often still safe to eat after that date. A “use by” date is different: it is about safety, so you should not eat the food after it.

There are simple ways to reduce waste. You can plan your meals for the week, make a shopping list and check your fridge before you go out. Leftovers can become a new meal the next day. Small changes like these save money and help the environment.

When the shop will offer a discount

Which idea is NOT mentioned as a way to reduce waste?

Using leftovers
Growing your own vegetables

Learning a Language Online
Tahmini seviye B1–B2
133 kelime
Dinle

Metni gizle (dinleme alıştırması)
Türkçe çeviriyi göster

Millions of people now use apps and websites to learn a new language. The main advantage is flexibility: learners can practise for ten minutes on the bus or during a lunch break, instead of travelling to a classroom at a fixed time.

However, online learning also has limitations. Many apps focus on recognising words rather than producing them, so learners may understand a lot but still find it difficult to speak. Without a teacher, it is also easy to repeat the same mistakes without noticing them.

Many teachers recommend a balanced approach. Short daily practice is useful for building vocabulary, but learners also need regular opportunities to speak and write, ideally with someone who can give them feedback. Studying a little every day matters more than studying for many hours once a week.

Vurgulu kelimeler (15)
Anlama soruları

What is the main advantage of learning online, according to the text?

It is always free.
It is flexible.
It replaces speaking practice.

Why might app users find speaking difficult?

Apps often focus on recognising words.
Apps are too expensive.
Apps do not teach vocabulary.

What does the last paragraph say matters most?

Studying for many hours in one day
Studying regularly
Using only one app
